reference: Expert multi-rater consensus lesion mask (three raters) shipped with the Ljubljana MS database, on the co-registered-resampled FLAIR grid the task hands out (voxel data as published; header taken from FLAIR, which the published mask misses by <= 0.4 mm).
threshold_basis: FIXED (published, dataset-specific): anchored on the LST-AI evaluation of the msljub dataset -- the same Ljubljana 30-patient cohort and the same three-rater consensus reference used here (Wiltgen et al. 2024, NeuroImage: Clinical 42:103611, doi:10.1016/j.nicl.2024.103611). Values are read from supplementary table anima_mean_scores, rows dataset=msljub. full = LST-AI, the best published method on this cohort (Dice 0.7425, lesion-wise F1 0.6972). pass, the zero-credit line = LST-LGA, the weakest published method on it (Dice 0.3727, F1 0.1545); the band between them also contains LST-LPA (0.3957/0.1822), nnUNet (0.4435/0.3116), samseg (0.4804/0.2564) and DeepLesionBrain (0.5541/0.3748). The F1 anchors transfer because the detection convention matches: Anima counts a reference lesion as detected at >=10% overlap, and overlap_frac_for_match is 0.1 here. One difference remains -- min_lesion_voxels drops components below 3 voxels on both sides, which Anima does not do -- so the F1 anchors are close rather than exact. abs_volume_err_pct is not from the paper; it is a tolerance of this benchmark's own choosing.
reference_notes: consensus lesion volume 52.706 cm3, 165 foci, largest 25.097 cm3; 117 foci at or above min_lesion_voxels and therefore counted by lesion_f1
references: Lesjak Z, Galimzianova A, Koren A, et al. A Novel Public MR Image Dataset of Multiple Sclerosis Patients With Lesion Segmentations Based on Multi-rater Consensus. Neuroinformatics 16:51-63, 2018. doi:10.1007/s12021-017-9348-7 (dataset and three-rater consensus reference standard; CC-BY).

Wiltgen T, McGinnis J, Schlaeger S, et al. LST-AI: A deep learning ensemble for accurate MS lesion segmentation. NeuroImage: Clinical 42:103611, 2024. doi:10.1016/j.nicl.2024.103611 (per-dataset Dice / lesion-wise F1 on msljub for LST-AI, LST-LPA, LST-LGA, SAMSEG and nnU-Net; source of the threshold anchors).
prompt: Segment the white-matter (FLAIR-hyperintense) MS lesions of patient12 of the open_ms_data cross-sectional dataset, producing a binary lesion mask in the FLAIR space of the co-registered resampled images.
